rationale: Although price has slipped slightly below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($18.22) to $18.19, selling volume on the pullback has dried up (dropping to 25k shares on the latest 1-minute bar) while price continues to hold near the $18.20 intraday support level and well above session VWAP ($18.01). With the $18.17 invalidation level only two cents away ($3.02 in remaining risk), the asymmetrical reward-to-risk from the current level favors holding to see if buyers defend this support zone.
